conflicts.description: Chartkeepers discover encoded evidence that past leaders concealed the true cause of the drifting islands, while rival enclaves accuse them of manufacturing the crisis to centralize power.
conflicts.name: The Hidden Drift Maps

conflicts.description: The Spansingers restrict passage until other factions surrender copies of their bridge lore, endangering relief shipments and inflaming accusations that they value secrets above lives.
conflicts.name: The Toll of Threnora

conflicts.description: Blackglass radicals propose severing unstable crossings to save the outer islands, but the Hollowbound warn that removing even one skybridge could scatter the entire archipelago.
conflicts.name: The Great Unbinding

description: Aelion Drift is a fractured fantasy realm of floating islands suspended above a luminous abyss. Ancient skybridge arcs of crystal and weathered stone bind the islands together, carrying travelers, harvests, messages, and songs from enclave to enclave. Each bridge resonates with a hidden harmonic that keeps the archipelago from scattering into the endless sky. When the resonances begin to fail, a young cartographer uncovers evidence that the drift patterns are deliberate rather than natural. To save the realm, they must persuade proud and suspicious enclaves to share long-guarded bridge lore before the islands drift beyond reach. Wondrous, perilous, and alive with light, Aelion Drift rewards curiosity while punishing isolation.

factions.description: Cartographers, navigators, and star-readers who record drift patterns and bridge harmonics. Their newest surveys reveal that the archipelago's fractures match deliberate alterations hidden in old maps.
factions.name: Chartkeepers of the Open Sky

factions.description: Traveling musicians and tollkeepers who memorize the vocal harmonies that calm each skybridge. They control passage through Threnora and guard songs older than any surviving map.
factions.name: Spansingers

factions.description: Windwrights and bridge-menders who bind lightning into blackglass tools. They believe the outer islands should break free before the failing core pulls every crossing down.
factions.name: Blackglass Guild

factions.description: Growers, water-callers, and harvest envoys who preserve Nymbel Hollow's floating gardens. They want all enclaves bound by treaty so food can reach every island during the drift crisis.
factions.name: Hollowbound Compact

history.description: The earliest islanders awakened the dormant crystal within the Radiant Causeway and learned to stretch its light into the first permanent skybridge.
The enclaves created the Chord Accord, assigning responsibility for each crossing to those who could hear and preserve its harmonic signature.
A failed alliance between Liora Vael and Cindral Reach left the eastern skybridge severed during a lightning season, beginning centuries of mistrust.
Nymbel Hollow rose from beneath the cloud veil with living roots entwined around ancient bridge-stone, proving that the network reached farther than known maps suggested.
The Threnora crossing missed its dawn note for the first time in recorded memory, revealing that the bridges were losing their shared harmony.

locations.description: The largest island and seat of the Chartkeepers, whose terraced observatories and map-halls overlook the inner archipelago. Its famous skybridge, the Radiant Causeway, hums beneath ribbons of dawn-colored light.
locations.name: Liora Vael

locations.description: A narrow market island built along the longest surviving skybridge. Musicians tune wind-bells to the bridge's fading notes so merchants can judge when it is safe to cross.
locations.name: Threnora Span

locations.description: A storm-scoured island of blackglass terraces, lightning gardens, and workshops powered by captured wind. Its artisans maintain the eastern crossings but distrust Liora Vael's maps.
locations.name: Cindral Reach

locations.description: A verdant underside island where orchards grow beneath hanging stone and water rises in silver streams. The Hollow feeds much of the realm but has almost no defensible crossings of its own.
locations.name: Nymbel Hollow

name: Aelion Drift

rules.statement: Islands remain aloft through layered sky-currents; objects that leave an island's influence fall toward the luminous depths unless caught by windcraft or tether-lines.
Every skybridge possesses a distinct harmonic identity, and sustained disharmony causes its crystal supports to fade, fracture, or release their anchored islands.
Chartkeepers may not knowingly falsify a public map, though they may encode dangerous knowledge in symbols understood only by sworn readers.
Craft, lifts, sails, and bridge-mending tools rely on tuned crystal, captured lightning, woven cloud-silk, and wind pressure rather than combustion.
No enclave may blockade food-bearing routes during a declared Driftfast, when all islands must ration together or face exile from the bridge network.
